content: Implement a source-local Vulkan host-visible staging allocation adapter for W0132, including generation-bound VkBuffer/VkDeviceMemory creation, memory-type selection, mapping, and non-coherent flush/invalidate without changing the stable backend C ABI.

Committed a9ba189. Built the optional Vulkan target with the pinned .#vulkan shell and ran the full .#vulkan-runtime CTest suite: 90/90 passed on the current AMD/RADV host, including metaflux.backend.vulkan-device. The source-local adapter allocates and binds a host-visible VkBuffer/VkDeviceMemory, maps it, guards ranges, and exercises flush/invalidate; stable C ABI remains unchanged.
